title: Translation Of A Letter From The Kiangsu Bureau Of Foreign Affairs

page_data.en:

C.I.D. HEADQUARTERS.
POLITICAL BRANCH.
Shanghai, 29.11.29. 19
To Chinese Section
Please note contents
of attached letter
& anticipating leftist
propaganda.
J.R.
Note:-
Information conveyed
to Staff for necessary attention
Information also conveyed
to Staff & attempt made to
trace author of letter.
J.R. 2.12.29
29/12/29

1929年12月29日

page_data.en:
702
28.11.29
November 27, 29.

Sir,

I have to acknowledge receipt of your letter of
November 26 requesting assistance from the Municipal
Police in suppressing the activities of certain reactionaries,
who are in the habit of fabricating rumours defamatory to
the National Government, and to prevent the circulation
of propaganda in the form of literature prepared by these
parties, and to inform you in reply that the matter is
now receiving attention.

Yours faithfully,

A/ Director of Criminal Investigation.

Mr. Showin Wetsen Hsu,
President Shanghai Provisional Court.

C.D.J. Robertson,
For attention
page_data.zh:
702
1929年11月28日
1929年11月27日。

先生，

谨此确认收到阁下11月26日来信，请求工部局
警务处协助镇压某些反动分子的活动，
这些人惯于捏造诽谤
国民政府的谣言，并防止这些党派
编写的文献形式的宣传品流传，现回复告知
此事正受到关注。

此致，

代理刑事侦缉处处长。

徐秀文·韦森·许（Showin Wetsen Hsu）先生，
上海临时法院院长。

C.D.J. Robertson，
供阅知

Translation,
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. L. O. D..7..2..
Date..27.-11.-29.
Shanghai Provisional Court,
Shanghai, November 1929.

Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council,

Sir,

I have received a letter from the Kiangsu Bureau of Foreign
Affairs quoting Secret Instruction No.2759 received from the
Ministry of Foreign Affairs quoting Instruction No.894 received
from the National Government quoting letter from the Central
Executive Committee of the Koumintang Party in China stating
as follows:-

"It is found that the Reactionary Party
has lately appeared in different places
using the name of the Koumintang Joint
Associations or the Koumintang Bureaus
in a certain place in defaming the Central
Government with a view to disturb the minds
of the populace and bring trouble to the
Government. This should be strictly prohi-
bited. At our 35th Meeting held it is decided
that the Government be requested to forward
a circular telegram to the Military and poli-
tical Organs in the whole Country for their
strict and secret prohibitions of the reac-
tionary printed matters without letting them
to have the same secretly distributed and
for strict punishments to be meted out to
these reactionaries without letting them to
start rumours again to disturb the minds of
the populace. At the same time we will also
page_data.zh:
译文，
上海公共租界工部局
刑事侦缉处登记室
编号 L.O.D.702
日期 1929年11月27日。
上海临时法院，
上海，1929年11月。

警务处处长，
上海公共租界工部局，

先生，

本人收到江苏省外交局的一封来信，援引自外交部收到的第2759号秘密指令，该指令又援引自国民政府收到的第894号指令，后者又援引中国国民党中央执行委员会的来信，内容如下：-

“查反动派
近期在各地出现，
借用某地国民党联合协会
或国民党办事处的名义，
诽谤中央政府，意图扰乱
民心并给政府制造麻烦。对此应严加
禁止。在我方召开的第35次会议上，
决定请政府向全国军事和政治
机关转发通令电报，要求他们
严格且秘密地禁止反动
印刷品，不得让其秘密分发，
并对这些反动分子施以严厉惩罚，
不得让他们再次散布谣言扰乱
民心。同时，我方也将

page_data.en:
2.
forward a circular telegram to the whole
of the Kuomintang Members and the people
for their assistance in doing away with
the reactionary movements. It is requested
that
the matter be dealt with accordingly."
"This should be done accordingly.
Apart from forwarding a reply and having
separate instructions issued, you are hereby
secretly instructed to execute accordingly
and issue orders in turn for its strict and
secret prohibitions and for punishments to
be meted out."
"Apart from submitting a prompt
reply and having separate instructions
issued, you are hereby instructed in turn
for strict and secret investigations and
apprehensions."
"You, President of the Shanghai
Provisional Court, are requested to execute
accordingly."
In consequence of the above, you are requested to give order
for strict and secret investigations and apprehensions to be
made.

Shoria Hotson Hsu,
President.

向全体国民党党员和民众
转发通令电报，
请求他们协助消除
反动运动。请
据此处理此事。”
“应照此办理。
除复函并发布单独指令外，
现秘密指令你方据此执行，
并依次发布命令，实行严格
且秘密的禁令及实施惩罚。”
“除迅速复函并发布单独
指令外，现指令你方依次
进行严格且秘密的调查
和逮捕。”
“上海
临时法院院长，请据此
执行。”
鉴于上述情况，请下令
进行严格且秘密的调查
和逮捕。

徐绍仁·霍特森·许（Shoria Hotson Hsu），
院长。
